scientific_core.nontriviality_policy: No reported observable is accepted; copied public coefficient data have no valid native design arrays. Binary, inventory, calibrated processing, and actual cooperative kinetics are replayed.

shared_artifact_policy.separation_basis: One native design carries distinct orientation validity, control domain, mass conservation, resource budgets, compatibility, nominal bottleneck, nominal mean response, and joint intervention robustness claims; no final scalar is submitted or trusted.

authenticity_checks: native array types, dimensions, identities and physical domain
causal_checks: full independent cooperative trapping and processing replay
qa_fixtures: forged observables on a wrong native design

dependency_locality.extras: Unrequested files and observable fields are ignored; no deduction and no credit
